subject: general
question: Name the location of the National Institute of Rehabilitation Training and Research (NIRTAR)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cuttack, Odisha**__.

**__Key Points__**
__

• The **National Institute of Rehabilitation Training and Research (NIRTAR)**, now officially known as the **Swami Vivekanand National Institute of Rehabilitation Training and Research (SVNIRTAR)**, is located in **Olatpur**, which is approximately **30 kilometers** from **Cuttack** in the state of **Odisha**.

• It is a premier **autonomous body** functioning under the **Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan)**, which is part of the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**, **Government of India**.

• The institute was originally established in **1975** as a service center under the **Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India (ALIMCO)** and later achieved its current **autonomous status** in **1984**.

• The core objective of the institute is to provide high-quality **rehabilitation services** for persons with **locomotor disabilities**, conduct **research** in the field of **rehabilitation engineering** and **medical sciences**, and develop trained **human resources**.

• The location in **Cuttack** serves as a vital medical hub for patients from across **Eastern India**, offering specialized **rehabilitative surgery** and **vocational training** to help individuals lead independent lives.

**Additional Information__**
__

• **Academic Excellence**: **SVNIRTAR** offers several undergraduate and postgraduate courses, including **Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT)**, **Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (BOT)**, and **Bachelor of Prosthetics and Orthotics (BPO)**, all of which are affiliated with **Utkal University**.

• **Hospital Infrastructure**: The institute operates a **100-bed hospital** that specializes in **orthopedic surgery** for conditions such as **polio**, **cerebral palsy**, **congenital deformities**, and **spinal cord injuries**.

• **National Network**: The **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** manages several other national institutes, such as the **National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD)** in **Dehradun** and the **Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech and Hearing Disabilities (AYJNISHD)** in **Mumbai**.

• **Outreach Services**: The institute actively organizes **assessment camps** and **outreach programs** under the **ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)** to distribute free **assistive devices** in rural and underserved areas.

• **Regional Presence**: To expand its reach, **SVNIRTAR** manages **Composite Regional Centres (CRCs)** located in **Ranchi**, **Guwahati**, and **Sikkim**, providing localized support for the **Divyangjan** population.

**Important Points__**

• The institute is named after the great philosopher **Swami Vivekanand**, reflecting its mission of selfless service to humanity and the empowerment of the marginalized.

• It plays a critical role in implementing the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016**, which mandates accessible healthcare and equal opportunities for persons with **21 recognized types of disabilities**.

• The **Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities** was officially given a separate identity within the Ministry in **May 2012** to focus specifically on policy issues and welfare schemes for the disabled.

• **SVNIRTAR** is also a recognized center for **DNB (Diplomate of National Board)** training in **Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation (PMR)**, contributing to the development of specialized medical professionals in **India**.
